test_title: PYST 1: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

The realtors of the new venture __sold plots like hot cakes.__

options.text: Sold quickly and in large numbers

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Sold quickly and in large numbers. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"sold like hot cakes"** means something that is sold very quickly and in large quantities. (बहुत तेजी से और बड़ी मात्रा में बेचा गया) • **Example: **The new smartphone model sold like hot cakes on the first day of its release. • **"Sold quickly and in large numbers" **refers to items being sold at a rapid pace and in significant quantities. (बहुत तेजी से और बड़ी मात्रा में बेचा गया) • **Example: **The concert tickets sold quickly and in large numbers, leaving many fans disappointed. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Sold quickly and in large numbers**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Sold illegally **(अवैध रूप से बेचा गया): Items being sold in a manner that is against the law. • **Example:** The black market goods were sold illegally to avoid taxes. • **Sold innovatively **(नवीन तरीके से बेचा गया): Items being sold using new and creative methods. • **Example: **The startup sold its products innovatively through social media campaigns. • **Sold with great difficulty **(बहुत कठिनाई से बेचा गया): Items being sold with a lot of effort and challenges. • **Example:** The outdated technology products were sold with great difficulty in the modern market. 3b:Taf0, The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
